title: MirageSITL aircraft profile schemas 1 to 7
description: Multirotor aircraft profile (TASK-138). SI units; positions are body FRD metres from the body reference point. Code checks what the schema cannot express: ascending unique arm and motor IDs, known arms, one single motor or one upper and one lower motor per arm, a pair separation exactly for pairs, unique outputs, distinct arm mounts, and realizable inertia tensors; and, from schema 2 (TASK-140), a calculation exactly in schema 2, no measurement set in preliminary mode, and measurement sets in ascending order without repeats; and, from schema 3 (TASK-143), a sensor configuration exactly in schema 3, which also needs a calculation and never equals the ArduPilot defaults, which are stored as null; and, from schema 4 (TASK-144), propeller polars exactly in schemas 4 and 5: in ascending card order, each for a propeller card that a motor uses and naming a polar-catalog entry, and one or more in schema 4; schemas 4 and 5 hold a sensor configuration or null; and, from schema 5 (TASK-096), stated airframe drag exactly in schema 5, with a source that is not blank; and, from schema 7 (TASK-196), a body exactly in schema 7, whose parts have unique names, whose arms all reach out of the body cylinder, and which makes at most 16 hull shapes with the arms.

cardReference.description: SHA-256 address of a component-card version in the project store (TASK-136, TASK-139), or null while none is selected.

matrix3.description: Row-major 3x3 tensor in body FRD axes.

lengthM.description: Horizontal distance from the body z axis through the reference point to the motor axis at the arm's mount.

azimuthRad.description: Angle in the body x-y plane from forward towards right, clockwise seen from above.

heightM.description: Height of the mount above the reference point; body FRD z is -heightM.

outwardTiltRad.description: Lean of the thrust axis away from the body z axis, measured in the arm's vertical plane.

sideTiltRad.description: Lean of the thrust axis towards increasing azimuth, measured in the vertical plane across the arm.

pairSeparationM.description: Distance between the two rotor hubs of a coaxial pair along the thrust axis; null for a single motor.

level.description: single: the only motor of its arm; upper: the pair motor on the thrust side; lower: the other pair motor.

spin.description: Rotation seen from the thrust side, which is from above for an untilted rotor.

output.description: ArduPilot servo output number (SERVOn); the actuator channel is output - 1.

massProperties.description: The aircraft as flown without payload: airframe, propulsion and battery.

payload.description: A rigid payload with its own CG and inertia about that CG (zero for a point mass), or null.

groundClearanceM.description: Height of the reference point above level ground when the aircraft rests on its supports (decision F-07), or null.

sensorConfiguration.description: null in schemas 1 and 2, meaning ArduPilot defaults; sensor configuration schema 1 in schema 3 (TASK-143); either in schema 4.

propellerPolars.description: Schemas 4 and 5 (TASK-144): the polar-catalog entry the BET rotors of each propeller card use; one or more in schema 4.

propulsionCalibrations.description: Schemas 6 and 7 (TASK-145): the propulsion calibrations this profile version binds, one per combination key, with the values of each calibration record; one or more in schema 6.

airframeDrag.description: Schema 5 only (TASK-096): drag areas the user states for the airframe without its rotors, with their source.

dragAreasM2.description: C_D·A along body x, y and z, m².

maxAirspeedMps.description: The top of the airspeed range the values hold for.

body.description: Schema 7 only (TASK-196): the airframe's contact shapes as the user describes them, in place of the standard hull. Depths are body FRD z, metres below the reference point.

diameterM.description: Diameter of the body cylinder about the body z axis.

bottomDepthM.description: How far the body's bottom lies below the reference point; negative when it lies above.

armDiameterM.description: Thickness of every arm, a capsule from the body axis to the motor mount at the arm's height.

parts.description: Parts fixed to the body, such as a camera or a cargo box, each a vertical cylinder.

xM.description: Body x (forward) of the part's axis.

yM.description: Body y (right) of the part's axis.

bottomDepthM.description: How far the part's bottom lies below the reference point.

calculation.description: Schemas 2, 3, 4 and 5 (TASK-140): the S04 calculation mode of this profile version and the measurement-set versions it binds.
